mentions.name: Detective-themed iOS visual novel
mentions.description: A detective-themed visual novel for iOS built with React Native, featuring a custom game engine; the focus is on writing a consistent, believable, and interesting story.
mentions.problem: Writing a story that is consistent, believable, and interesting has been the biggest challenge in building the narrative game.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m making a detective themed iOS-based visual novel with React Native.
